<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def reds(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','g','G'):
            r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            r1=max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c1=max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            out.append((n['color'],(r0,c0,r1,c1),n['pixels']))
    return sorted(out)
print('BEFORE any new SPACE:', reds(current_frame))
for k in range(3):
    r=action(['SPACE'])
    print('after SPACE',k+1,'res done=',r.get('done'),'level_completed=',r.get('level_completed'),'board_changed=',r.get('board_changed'))
    print('  reds:', reds(current_frame))
    if r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed') or r.get('game_over'):
        print('STOP'); break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def reds(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','g','G'):
            r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            r1=max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c1=max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            out.append((n['color'],(r0,c0,r1,c1),n['pixels']))
    return sorted(out)
print('BEFORE any new SPACE:', reds(current_frame))

    print('  reds:', reds(current_frame))
    if r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed') or r.get('game_over'):
